title: The limits on the chemistry sink terms
intro: max sink total [dimensionless]: Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of total content. If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep in; max sink solute [dimensionless]: Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of solute content. If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep; max sink secondary [dimensionless]: Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of secondary domain content. If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep. Each is varied from half to double the value the farm uses; none of them moved yield, water or nitrogen in the test, so the effect shows in the process itself.
